subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number series and answer the question.

7 2 9 6 3 8 3 8 7 2 3 2 7 3 2 2 1 3 3 9 9 7 4 2 9 3 0 9

Find the sum of number of occurrences of 2s and number of occurrences of 3s in the given series.
solution:
Given series → 7 2 9 6 3 8 3 8 7 2 3 2 7 3 2 2 1 3 3 9 9 7 4 2 9 3 0 9

Find the total numbers of 2s and 3s present in the series :**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e30ffb4aace04b49288498781afee3c8adcedb3b74e0b85d90876c341a53762.png] 

We can see that we have 6 twos & 7 threes so their addition will be:

⇒ 6 + 7

⇒ 13

Hence, the correct answer is "13".**
